display_name_zh: 总控维护｜稳定认知入口、系统性修复闭环、学习能力与有限验证收敛
governing_outcome: 在不增加额外付费 API/积分/Codex 依赖的前提下，让每个已选择 UAOS/域上下文的实质性回合稳定进入轻量控制入口，再由入口内部自主判定所需的执行、研究、认知、Deep Task、进化与验证深度；让未知方法/框架/知识学习具备可复用的覆盖式检索、比较、证伪、饱和停止和 holdout 能力；同时保持用户目标/约束 authority、当前 GitHub authority、系统性修复完整性和受保护 main 写入。
new_evidence: User identified a circular trigger problem: if unknown/complex/systemic classification is required before entry, the model can miss the very signal needed to enter cognition.

External Skill/prompt guidance and independent benchmark evidence support concise routing metadata, progressive disclosure, task-dependent reasoning depth and evaluation rather than comprehensive handholding prose.

Professional search/review methods support iterative query expansion, citation/reference snowballing, source-role coverage, contradiction handling and documented saturation rather than literal exhaustive-web claims.

Current UAOS outside-in discovery provides source/lens breadth but does not yet mechanically represent multi-source roles, expansion methods, method-family coverage, contradiction disposition or saturation evidence.

Current v2 Native Skill/Custom Instructions still encode some incident symptoms as governing prose and make the strongest problem gate conditional on problem/repair classification instead of mandatory selected-context entry.
selected_candidate_direction: mandatory lightweight selected-context entry before substantive response/tool/action
internal adaptive routing for ordinary execution / cognition / Deep Task / coverage-oriented research / evolution / mutation
coverage-oriented knowledge-acquisition receipt under existing problem-space/Deep Task owners
concise scope-based Skill metadata and router body rather than symptom ontology
positive autonomous goal loop as governing invariant; incident/no-op phrases primarily move to regression/eval cases
candidate account holdout before production promotion when feasible
remaining_user_owned_actions: after repository candidate is green, install the exact candidate Skill/Custom Instructions once for fresh-chat holdout before promotion if product UX permits
